description: Capability for the Settings window (M2/S6/S7). Same least-privilege discipline as capabilities/default.json's popover capability, scoped to the DIFFERENT, disjoint IPC surface this window actually calls: get_settings()/save_settings() only — never get_state/refresh_now/hide_popover (this window has no doctor-state concerns and never touches the popover's own show/hide lifecycle) and never open_settings_window (that grant belongs to the popover, the ONLY caller of it — see capabilities/default.json). No core:event:allow-listen here either: the Settings window is a get-on-open, save-round-trips-directly surface (no live 'state-changed'-style push it needs to subscribe to). No fs/shell/http/dialog plugin is linked at all — every manifest read/write/guard/pointer/re-poll step happens Rust-side, behind these two typed commands, never as a filesystem or process capability granted to the webview itself.
